newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil sets up new business area.
newsitem.headline: Statoil sets up new business area.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) said on Thursday it was establishing a 15th business area from May 1 under the preliminary name of Technology & Expertise.

Hived off from Exploration & Development Norway (LUN), this entity will embrace technology, procurement and project development expertise and services for Norway and internationally, the Status Weekly newsletter said.
It said LUN's other operations, including partner-operated licences, would remain with this business area.

Randi Grung Olsen, currently head of human resources for Statoil, will be senior vice president of the new business area, while vice president Tor Fjaeran from the exploration Norway unit takes over as senior vice president of LUN, the newsletter said.
